title: Relay-run step JSON lists every open question
lead: `relay-run list` (the JSON `question` field from `Step.to_dict` and the text line from `_question_line`) shows only a step's latest question. Since s425, an orchestrator asks every non-blocker owner question in the ledger as it arises, so several questions on one step can be open at once. A dashboard reading `list --json` then sees only the newest; s425 documented that it must read each by id with `relay-run answer RUN QUESTION_ID --get`.

Add a `questions` list to the step JSON with every question on the step (open and answered), keeping `question` as the latest for compatibility. The text line names the count of open questions when more than one is open.
findings_note: s425 review 2026-10-30, finding A1 (later by orchestrator default, docs-only fix landed with s425): `relay-run list` shows only a step's latest question, while several non-blocker questions can be open at once
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a dashboard UI, changing ask/answer semantics, or removing the `question` field.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A dashboard that answers owner questions should not need a per-id read to find the questions that the list already knows about. Without it, an earlier non-blocker stays unanswered until the orchestrator's `--get` before the finish step.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/relayrun.py`: `Step.to_dict` gains `questions` in a fixed key position.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: `_question_line` notes several open questions.
- `docs/agents.md` (relay-run list payload rows), `docs/commands.md` (Asking the owner), `docs/working-with-agents.md`: drop the latest-only caveat that s425 added.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_List_SeveralOpenQuestions_JsonListsEveryQuestion`: ask q1 and q2 without `--blocker`; the step's `questions` lists both with their open state, and `question` is still q2.
- `test_List_SeveralOpenQuestions_TextNamesOpenCount`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Add `questions` to the step dict after `question`, each entry in the same shape as `question`.
2. Update the text line and the three docs.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The new tests pass; `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, the full suite and `slicer check` stay green.
